why: 3.0.0 may publish only when every fleet package is merged and pinned on v3 and the config is flipped. The proof and the flip are mechanical and belong to a lead; the publish is the owner's (v3-ga).
what: GA runbook steps 1 and 2 (migration-release 4.5): prove the fleet, remove the temporary `basalt.sibling` key and its resolver branch, flip master's release config. Nothing is published.
must_not_touch: scripts/release.sh and release.test.ts (the gate changes only by a new CURRENT_MAJOR edit)
contract: docs/v3/concepts/migration-release.md sections 3.1, 4.3, 4.5 and exceptions 4, 6. The gate accepts 3.0.0 only with bump major and ga_ready=1 (`GA=1` and `fleet-status --ga` exit 0). The sibling key and its resolver branch were created by v3-cli-sibling; this Issue removes exactly that. Preconditions (ancestors): every G0-G5 gate row, both cutovers, v3-fleet-cutover-rows, the AI recipes and the epos probes.
exemplar: The rel-4 gate table in scripts/release.test.ts and the 2.29.1 release record for the wording of the reason.
change: 1. `bun packages/basalt-ui/scripts/fleet-status.ts --ga` exits 0 (read only; if red, stop and report the rows). 2. A `packages/basalt-ui/` commit removes `basalt.sibling` from the resolver, its fixture and its tests (the undeclared-second-install refusal stays); then a separate `ci:` commit sets master's .releaserc.json branches to ["master"]. Rule: release.test.ts gate table stays green. Skill snippet: none.
commits: Two commits in one PR: packages/basalt-ui/** apart from everything else (isolated-basalt-ui hook); `make sync-self` output its own non-package commit; conventional, empty scope, plain feat:/fix:/chore:/docs:, no feat! or BREAKING CHANGE, no attribution; rebase-merge. The `ci:` flip is its own commit.
proof: fleet-status --ga output attached; `GA=1 make release-dry` after the flip prints 3.0.0 with dist-tag latest.
acceptance: `rg -n 'sibling' packages/basalt-ui/src/cli` returns no match and `bun test packages/basalt-ui/src/cli` passes, including a test that an undeclared second consumer is still refused
`GA=1 make release-dry` prints 3.0.0 with dist-tag latest (dry run only; without GA=1 it must refuse 3.0.0)
rg -n "@mantine" packages/basalt-ui/src returns nothing and tests/required-peers.test.ts asserts an empty required-peer set
out_of_scope: Running make release, npm deprecate or any publish, editing the version gate, consumer bumps, deleting tools/migrate-v3.
